== Ingredients ==

=== '''Rub Ingredients''' ===
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] salt
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ½–1 tsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]] (depending on how spicy you like it)
* 2 tsp ground [[Cookbook:Coriander|coriander]]
* 1 tbsp smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]

=== Meat ===
* 2 bone-in [[Cookbook:Beef#Rib|ribeye steaks]] (sometimes called a rib steak)
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]] (any type)

== Procedure ==
#Combine all rub ingredients.
#Coat steaks with mustard and apply rub to steaks.
#Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
#Heat a [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] as high as it will go.
#Place steaks on grill and cook 2–3 minutes per side.
#Move steaks to medium grill heat. Cook until desired [[Cookbook:Meat#Doneness|doneness]], turning frequently.
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes; [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.
